description: This file defines the interface MonkeyEventSource, which specifies methods for obtaining the next event, setting verbosity, and validating preconditions within the Android Monkey testing framework.

classes.name: MonkeyEventSource
classes.description: An interface defining the contract for event sources in the Android Monkey testing framework.

methods.name: getNextEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the next monkey event from the source.

methods.name: setVerbose
methods.description: Sets the verbosity level for logging output; 1 for verbose, 2 for very verbose.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Checks whether preconditions for event generation are satisfied; returns false if checks fail.
